title: 第十七章 爱第十八章 直到死
lines: 魏公公汗流浃背了。
你知道一只老虎多凶残多骇人，和亲自面对一直老虎是两回事。
更何况眼前的扭曲之物并非猛虎。
而是比猛虎更加可怖，比杀人鲸还要残暴，是超越凡俗之存在！是可以手撕禁军，徒手发射炮弹的神皇！
只有神皇有形的大手抓住自己的脑袋时。
才能够深刻的感受，自己的头颅可能随时都会碎裂爆开所带来的巨大压力，这股压力直接让见过无数明枪暗箭，宫廷血腥，大风大浪的魏公公直接五体投地！
就在司礼监提督以为自己会被发怒的圣天子给捏死的时候。
左墟那择人而噬，撼动宫柱的气势却是猛地收了起来。
他那宛若天籁之音的声音仿佛从很高很遥远的地方垂落。
“魏内侍，何必五体投地，不看僧面也看佛面，朕看在先帝的面子上不会把你手撕的。”
“谢，谢陛下！！”
魏国忠如蒙大赦，汗如雨下的他没有起身，反而是深深的伏地。
“这样吧，朕有一件事正好适合你这司礼监提督去做，做得好，朕就用你，今天的事情也就一笔勾销吧。”
“老奴是先帝的家奴，也是陛下的家奴，能被吩咐是老奴的福气，这把老骨头还能为陛下效力是老奴的运气。”
难怪能讨曜灵帝的喜欢。
不仅是长得喜气，这话说的也是好听，你知道他是在奉承，但听着就是舒服，当皇帝的如果情绪价值都没人提供了，那还不如去死了。
“符清辞，听说过么？”左墟蹲了下来，他眼眸幽深不可测。
“老奴知晓此人，此子目中无人，曾对先帝无礼，先帝宽宏大量免其死罪。”魏国忠当即给这位浊世佳公子的罪状列好了。
“把他带到朕面前来，你们东厂的手艺一直可信，朕要看到一个小清子，你明白朕的意思么？”
“老奴明白。”
司礼监提督从六品，提督东厂、西厂。
大曜东西两厂，在太祖时代还算天子鹰犬，但现如今已经成了皇宫环卫的角色。
但破船尚有二两钉。
赎罪军这群丘八让他们杀杀杀没啥问题，可让他们去大张旗鼓去抓人，只怕要么人抓不到要么抓过来一具尸体。
所以这活交给魏公公正适合。
站起来伸了一个懒腰，肌肉线条如同大理石雕塑的左墟身上噼里啪啦作响，他眼眸低垂脸上带上了一丝倦意。
惯性使然，心灵松弛。
眼瞅着入夜了，他忽然想歇歇，也顺便整理一下刚刚降下神皇恩典时短暂出现的隔空力量。
“朕乏了。”
“圣上，摆架景阳宫？”雪梅抿嘴请示。
景阳宫是司贵妃的地。
眼下肯定不能让皇后侍寝，圣天子留着柳令仪的后位就是为了羞辱她，都嫌她脏了更不可能碰她。
“没必要那么麻烦了，坤宁宫就不错，你和花蝶留下来伺候朕就行了，其他人退下去吧。”
被点名的两位大宫女身体骤然紧绷。
两个人能抗住圣天子的巨龙炮么？
“圣上~那这罪妇呢？”
content_en:
Eunuch Wei was sweating profusely.
You know how ferocious and scary a tiger is, and facing a tiger in person are two different things.
What's more, the twisted thing in front of him is not a tiger.
Rather, it is more terrifying than a tiger, more brutal than a killer whale, and an existence that transcends the ordinary world! He is the God-Emperor who can tear apart the imperial army with his bare hands and fire cannonballs with his bare hands!
Only when the visible hands of the God-Emperor grasped his head.
Only then could he deeply feel the huge pressure brought about by the fact that his head might break and explode at any time. This pressure directly made Eunuch Wei, who had seen countless open and secret arrows, blood in the palace, and strong winds and waves, throw himself to the ground!
Just when the Superintendent of Ceremonies thought he would be crushed to death by the angry Holy Emperor.
Zuo Xu's aura of choosing people to eat and shaking the palace pillars suddenly stopped.
His voice, which was like the sound of nature, seemed to fall from a very high and far away place.
"Minister Wei, why are you bowing down and not looking at the monk's face but also the Buddha's face? For the sake of the late Emperor, I won't tear your hands apart."
"Thank you, thank you Your Majesty!!"
Wei Guozhong felt as if he had been granted amnesty. He was sweating profusely and did not get up. Instead, he fell deeply to the ground.
"Well, I have something that is suitable for you, the Supervisor of Ceremonies, to do. If you do it well, I will use you, and today's matter will be written off."
"The old slave is the late emperor's domestic slave and also the servant of His Majesty. It is the old slave's blessing to be commanded. It is the old slave's luck that this old bone can still serve His Majesty."
No wonder he could please Emperor Yao Ling.
Not only does he look happy, but his words also sound nice. You know he is flattering, but it sounds comfortable. If no one can provide you with the emotional value of being an emperor, then you might as well die.
"Fu Qingci, have you heard of it?" Zuo Xu squatted down, his eyes dark and unfathomable.
"This old slave knows this man. He is arrogant and rude to the late emperor. The late emperor was magnanimous and exempted him from the death penalty." Wei Guozhong immediately listed the charges against this troubled young master.
"Bring him to me. Your Dongchang's craftsmanship has always been trustworthy. I want to see a little Qingzi. Do you understand what I mean?"
"Old slave understands."
The ceremonial supervisor is from the sixth rank, supervising the East Factory and the West Factory.
Dayao's two factories, East and West, were still regarded as emperor's hawks in the Taizu era, but now they have become the role of palace sanitation guards.
But there are still two nails left in the broken ship.
The Atonement Army and the Qiuba have no problem letting them kill and kill, but if they are allowed to arrest people in a big way, they are afraid that they will either fail to catch the people or they will catch a corpse.
Therefore, it is appropriate to leave this job to Mr. Wei.
Zuo Xu stood up and stretched. His muscles were crackling like marble sculptures. His eyes were lowered and there was a trace of tiredness on his face.
Due to inertia, the mind is relaxed.
Seeing that it was getting dark, he suddenly wanted to take a rest and sort out the short-lived power that had just appeared when the God Emperor's grace fell.
"I'm tired."
"Your Majesty, are you planning on setting up Jingyang Palace?" Xuemei pursed her lips and asked for instructions.
Jingyang Palace is the place of Concubine Si.
The Queen must not be allowed to sleep with her at the moment. The Holy Emperor kept Liu Lingyi's post just to humiliate her. He thought she was dirty and would not touch her.
"There's no need to go to such trouble. Kunning Palace is just fine. You and Hua Die can stay here to serve me. Everyone else should leave."
The bodies of the two maids who were named suddenly tensed up.
Can two people withstand the Holy Emperor's dragon cannon?
"Your Majesty, what about this sinful woman?"
